sentences.text: Cougar Town was an American television sitcom that ran for 102 episodes over six seasons , from September 23 , 2009 until March 31 , 2015 .	sitcom	sitcom
The first three seasons aired on ABC , with the series moving to TBS for the final three seasons .	ABC	American Broadcasting Company	TBS	TBS (U.S. TV channel)

Set in the fictional town of Gulfhaven , Florida , nicknamed `` Cougar Town '' since its high school teams are the Cougars , the series focuses on a recently divorced woman in her 40s facing the often humorous challenges , pitfalls , and rewards of life 's next chapter , along with her teenage son , her ex-husband , and her wine-loving friends who together make up her dysfunctional , but supportive and caring , extended family .	Florida	Florida
The pilot episode was broadcast after Modern Family .	pilot episode	pilot episode	Modern Family	Modern Family
ABC officially gave the series a full season pickup on October 8 , 2009 .	ABC	American Broadcasting Company

The show was created by Bill Lawrence and Kevin Biegel and was produced by Doozer and Coquette Productions in association with ABC Studios .	Bill Lawrence	Bill Lawrence (TV producer)	Kevin Biegel	Kevin Biegel	Doozer	Doozer (company)	Coquette Productions	Coquette Productions	ABC Studios	ABC Studios	ABC	American Broadcasting Company
Filming took place at Culver Studios in Culver City , California .	Culver Studios	Culver Studios
The pilot episode achieved 11.28 million viewers .	pilot episode	pilot episode
Season 2 premiered on September 22 , 2010 , with 8.35 million viewers .
Season 3 , consisting of 15 episodes , was originally slated to premiere in November 2011 but , because of ABC 's promotion of the ill-fated Man Up !	ABC	American Broadcasting Company

Following the Season 3 finale , it was announced that TBS had purchased the rights to the series for an additional 15-episode season , to air in 2013 , with options for additional seasons .	TBS	TBS (U.S. TV channel)
On March 25 , 2013 , TBS renewed the series for a fifth season of 13 episodes , which premiered on January 7 , 2014 .	TBS	TBS (U.S. TV channel)
On May 10 , 2014 , TBS renewed Cougar Town for a sixth and final season .	TBS	TBS (U.S. TV channel)
Season six premiered on January 6 , 2015 , and the series concluded on March 31 , 2015 .
